---
Title: "Mallard Duck Map"
Author: "Andrew Lucas"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)

mallards_sf <- readRDS("data/mallards.rds") |>
  filter(lat >= 46, lat <= 55, long >= 7, long <= 25) |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("long", "lat"), crs = 4326)

world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = world, fill = "#d9d9d9", color = "#6c757d", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_sf(
    data = mallards_sf,
    aes(color = duck_id),
    size = 0.25,
    alpha = 0.65,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "plasma", end = 0.9) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(7, 25), ylim = c(46, 55), expand = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title = "Mallard GPS fixes",
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude",
    color = "Duck"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```
